Title: Folklore and Traditional Customs: Rituals, Beliefs, and Community Life
description: Across communities, customary celebrations, oral traditions, and shared beliefs help shape collective identity. Drawing on examples of seasonal rituals, storytelling, and everyday social practices, this study explores how folklore is preserved, adapted, and passed between generations.

Title: Latin Etymology and Word Formation: A Historical Guide
description: Tracing the development of Latin vocabulary, this guide examines roots, prefixes, suffixes, and patterns of semantic change. Carefully selected word histories illustrate how Latin forms evolved and how their meanings can be interpreted through historical linguistic evidence.
